Metadata.title: Wanwankewu • Say it, play it, make it
Metadata.description: Wanwankewu turns a sentence or a single image into pictures, video, audio and 3D models. Pick a quality tier, pay only for what you generate, and use curated models without touching parameters or deployment.

Landing.headline: Turn a sentence into images, video and 3D
Landing.subheading: From concept art and character design to short clips and 3D models — pick a quality tier and let us handle the rest.
Landing.seoTitle: Create AI images and videos from text in one studio
Landing.seoDescription: 玩玩可物 combines text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-image, and image-to-video tools for concept design, characters, visual pitches, social media assets, and short-form video.

Landing.footer: © 2026 玩玩可物 • AI Media Studio
Landing.tagline: Say it. Play it. Make it.
Landing.aboutTitle: Making AI generation something you can just play with
Landing.aboutBody1: No models to learn, no parameters to tune, no GPUs to rent. Open the page, describe the shot you want, pick a quality tier, and leave the rest to us. Text-to-image, image-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, image-to-video, plus audio and 3D models — one account, one credit balance, all of it.
Landing.aboutBody2: We keep the complexity backstage: choosing models, adapting parameters, scheduling compute. All you see up front is what you want and what it costs. The AI Models shelf keeps getting new arrivals worth trying — jump in, and move on if one doesn't fit.
Landing.aboutBody3: Credits are pay-per-use, so you can start without a subscription; membership adds discounts and higher tiers. Everything you generate is private to you, retention windows are stated plainly, and you can download anything to keep.

imagine.title: Say it, play it, make it
imagine.body: The barrier to creating should be imagination — not a GPU and a parameter sheet.

simple.title: Complexity stays backstage
simple.body: Models, compute and compatibility are our problem. You just say what you want.

fresh.title: The shelf keeps changing
fresh.body: We don't bet on one model. Good ones go up, stale ones come down.

clear.title: No surprises
clear.body: What it costs, how long it's kept, who can see it — all stated up front.
